meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文章、笔记或主题变成一段有画面有解说的讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把现成文字内容做成不露脸的讲解视频发出去
copy.tagline_en: Turn an article, notes or topic into a narrated explainer video with custom visuals
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you turn written ideas into faceless explainer videos to publish online

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会把一段文字(文章、笔记、话题或简报)做成无出镜解说视频:每个场景的视觉都是现编的(排版、抽象图形、图表、数据可视化),没有网站或素材截取环节,最后渲染出视频文件。
howto.when: 当你给出一段文字、想做话题解说或概念拆解等类视频时接管;从网站生成视频不归它管,意图不明确先走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这篇关于复利的文章做成无出镜解说视频
say.note: 先确认简报,再逐帧搭建

say.text: 用我的笔记做一个概念拆解视频,大约三分钟
say.note: 时长写进故事板交你确认

say.text: 这段脚本一个字都别改,按原文配音

howto.what_en: Claude turns a piece of text (article, notes, topic, brief) into a faceless explainer video: visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz), with no site or footage capture, and renders the final video file.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you give text and want a topic explainer or concept breakdown video; videos built from a website are out of scope, and unclear intent goes to /hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Turn this article about compound interest into a faceless explainer video
say_en.note: Confirms the brief, then builds frames

say_en.text: Make a concept breakdown video from my notes, about three minutes long
say_en.note: Length goes into the storyboard for your review

say_en.text: Keep this script word for word and narrate it as written
